response.sql: WITH status_stats AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scancount, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_scan_minute FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE CAST(sc.chronotag AS TEXT) BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY si.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_scan_minute) AS mean_status_average FROM status_stats) SELECT s.status, s.total_scancount, s.avg_gb_per_scan_minute, s.avg_gb_per_scan_minute - o.mean_status_average AS gap_from_mean FROM status_stats AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_status_average IS NOT NULL
